## Description

GERIATRIC_ASSESSMENT with date and author: falls in 12 months, Timed Up and Go seconds, lying and standing blood pressure (the drop is calculated and flagged as orthostatic at 20 systolic or 10 diastolic), Clinical Frailty Scale 1–9, Mini-Cog 0–5, ADL and IADL, PHQ-2 and a nutrition note. The medicine review lists suggestions from a small rule set (benzodiazepines, a proton pump inhibitor for more than 8 weeks, oral NSAIDs, and an ACE inhibitor or ARB with low eGFR and high potassium) as "suggestions, the doctor decides", each with a "plan change" action.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Each score is refused outside its scale and the orthostatic drop is tested at the flag line.
- [ ] **AC2.** The medicine review never changes a medicine by itself; a planned change goes to the consultation plan.
- [ ] **AC3.** shortcut: the flag lines and the rule set wait for clinical sign-off.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
